problem: Actual C12 queues camera only after a synchronous ordinary business action completes. A known battle epoch can advance multiple days before its first new camera intent. A preceding AUTO may already have centered it; source timing alone does not prove every live battle was missed.

original_boundaries.semantics: Before advancing, the actual planning snapshot already contains allied current province and in_combat. Existing tactical composite arms and validates the sentinel, submits resume-map, waits for its native stop, then returns to AUTO; no camera request during that original interval.

composition_recipe: Service.auto_turn: add the one relative import, wrap only the existing _execute_planned_turn call in camera_pre_advance_scope_v1. Do not copy the whole method from master: existing M7 successor-owner changes differ from actual C12 and are not this package.

NativeDriver._execute_primitive_step: one default-None private keyword; only the tactical internal resume supplies context. Invoke the scoped callback using this primitive's already acquired snapshot after all existing SDK guards/deadline checks, immediately before endpoint.send.

NativeDriver._execute_battle_sentinel_advance: initialize a private per-resume capture, pass it only to resume-map after the original arm validator returns, and expose an optional camera_pre_advance_v1 receipt on the final result. Original algorithm/clock/control code remains unchanged.
Worker: add urgent=False plus one bounded urgent pending slot; keep ordinary post scheduling and its quiet/coalescing behavior. Never replace an urgent pending item with ordinary post work.

safety_boundary.before_submit: Original callback order, exceptions and mapping interception are unchanged. Return None only means no interception; the camera callback is not triggered there.
safety_boundary.SDK_guards: No pre camera enqueue for a rejected existing SDK guard. Even an H3937 hold activated after valid sentinel arm is checked by the existing resume primitive before camera dispatch.
safety_boundary.location: The callback sees the exact existing resume submission snapshot, not the earlier speed snapshot and not a planning position relabeled with a new date. Require complete same actor/episode/PID/connection owner, same planning date, monotonic revisions, paused alive map and no known mandatory/event/interaction.
safety_boundary.eligible: Only already mapped battle or moving_player_army/army_destination at this verified tactical point. Static siege/objective/idle, unknown build, unavailable mapping or changed frame are skipped. Unsupported/nonadvancing/guard-rejected paths never reach the point.
safety_boundary.build: Require actual cached 1.20.0.4 executable identity before scheduling; no capability discovery.
safety_boundary.scope: Only the real exact NativeHeadlessGameplayDriver during this ordinary AUTO dispatch. Callback is one-shot and removed/restored in finally even on display/guard/business errors. The Driver defaults to no hook outside this scope.
safety_boundary.exception: Callback/scheduling errors become optional presentation diagnostics. They cannot authorize resume, replay a command or hide the original business/guard result.
safety_boundary.atomicity: Presentation mailbox and gameplay pipe are asynchronous. An already SDK-validated request can still be rejected by Native after camera enqueue. No atomic Native-rejection/zero-camera guarantee is claimed; no handshake, new read or settled wait is added.
safety_boundary.cost: Zero added Game snapshot/capability/MCP/Native query RPC. Reuse the existing guarded primitive snapshot. Additional asynchronous camera work/publications may occur before a legal advance; camera availability grants no Game credit.

worker_contract.default: Without urgent requests, one latest ordinary pending item, original quiet_seconds=.25, preserved pending eligible_at and failure isolation remain.
worker_contract.urgent: Only this pre-hook requests urgent=True. It is eligible immediately; ordinary post work occupies a separate single bounded slot. New urgent intent may coalesce an older urgent intent and discards an older ordinary frame to avoid backwards presentation.
worker_contract.post: The existing post-turn current-cache refresh remains. It cannot overwrite a not-yet-executed urgent pre item; one worker executes pre first and then the latest post.
worker_contract.limits: No settled wait, no second worker, no unbounded queue. Work cannot interrupt an already running camera operation. Urgent scheduling does not prove when Native pixels settle.

preserved_intermediate_pass.scope: Arm-validated point before final primitive hold review; retained historical check, superseded by final endpoint point plus late-hold negative.
